result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops `all_files.zip` or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the fix itself is untested.

In `DataExporter.java`, the export used to read five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` names. It now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. It gets each file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same call that writes the loose text files. It reads each file under that name and uses the same name for the zip entry.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and the existing `git-history.zip` step now runs as well.
